title: EEMS Platform — Overview
seo_title: EEMS Platform — Overview | Achala IT Solutions
meta_description: Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — with the evidence to defend every one.

blocks.x: The Achala IT Solutions build of EEMS Platform — Overview: concrete interfaces at core systems, measured movement on primary metric, and a delivery rhythm your control owners can plan around from week one.

EEMS Platform is the decision infrastructure for high-volume enterprise choices: credit, claims, pricing, triage, fraud, routing. It combines predictive models, business rules and agentic reasoning behind one governed decision API, with champion-challenger testing and full decision replay — so any decision can be reconstructed months later for an auditor, a customer or a court.

blocks.title: EEMS Platform — control and evidence planes
blocks.note: The decision layer is shared infrastructure: one contract per consumer, one ledger per decision, one owner per metric.

blocks.x: The reference pattern behind EEMS Platform — Overview is boring on purpose: contracts at every boundary, an owner per component, and evidence captured where the work happens. Boring architecture is what survives contact with an audit.

Nexus enforces separability by design: models score, policy decides, humans supervise. Risk teams change policy without retraining; data scientists ship models without touching code paths; compliance inspects what actually ran on any given day. It is the platform underneath our decision-intelligence services and the control point for every automated decision we deploy.

Query latency measured at p95 from real workloads — the number users feel is the number reported.
